title: Unlock files or folders to allow changes
summary: Use the chflags command with the 'nouchg' flag to remove the read-only lock from files or folders. This restores normal editing and deletion permissions.

steps.explain: Run chflags with the -R (recursive) and nouchg flags to unlock a directory and all its contents.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the directory to unlock
